title: 7 March 1961: Live: Cassanova Club, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ sixth performance at the Cassanova Club, promoted by Sam R Leach.

The Cassanova Club was situated above Sampson & Barlow’s Restaurant at 39 London Road, Liverpool. The club was previously sited in The Temple, Dale Street, Liverpool, but moved to this location on 9 February 1961.

The Beatles played at the Cassanova Club on seven occasions. The other dates were 11, 14, 16, 21 and 28 February, and 12 March 1961.

The Beatles had performed at the Cassanova on the date of the original venue’s opening (date unknown), but Ray McFall, owner of the Cavern Club, told them they were not allowed to play at both venues. The restriction was later lifted, and The Beatles played many times at events promoted by Sam Leach.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Tokyo Dome, Tokyo

  • 1975: Recording: Rock Show by Wings
  • 1973: Television: James Paul McCartney
  • 1973: Recording: Oh My My by Ringo Starr
  • 1972: Recording: When The Night by Wings
  • 1967: Recording: Lovely Rita
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Mersey Beat Showcase, Nottingham
  • 1962: Radio: Teenager’s Turn – Here We Go – The Beatles’ first radio session
